detailed_descriptions.en: Dwarf Eats Mountain is a strategic incremental game about devouring mountains for gold. Hire dwarves, deploy war machines, and collect powerful artifacts to build absurd synergies and grow faster each run. Hurting the mountain physically (and emotionally) is only half the battle— you still have to safely haul the gold home. That perilous job falls to the Runners, who weave through falling rocks, risking their beards to feed the Great Maw! But beware—the Great Mother won’t give up her treasure easily. The more damage your greedy dwarves deal to the mountain, the more calamities it unleashes upon the wobbling beards below! Balance mining with hauling your gold home—before the sky falls on your head. Master the dwarven ways of treasure extraction! This game is about making numbers go up, but the way you do that is open to your interpretation and ingenuity. At your fingertips: Many buildings and dwarves, each with various strengths and weaknesses, such as dynamite throwers, ballistas, flamers, laser cannons, spelunkers, runesmiths, brewmasters, bulldozers, gyrocopters and more! Acquire countless upgrades and cast active rituals to buff your dwarves and their machines Collect 120+ ancient artifacts and display them in your gallery, each with build-shaping effects Unlock 96+ prestige upgrades to replay, accelerate progress, and discover new synergies Spend rare resources like mithril and mountain souls on tough choices Uncover what the gods have hidden beneath the world spire—and what happened to those who dug too deep
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《 矮人吞山 》是一款策略性的放置类游戏，核心玩法就是啃山夺金。 招募矮人、部署战争机器、收集强力神器 ，搭配出天马行空的联动效果，让每一轮成长都更加迅猛。 从肉体（到精神）上摧毁山峰只是成功的一半—— 你还得把黄金平安运回营地 。这项凶险的差事落在了“搬运工”头上，他们在落石间穿梭，冒着失去胡须的风险，只为喂饱“巨口”！ 但小心——大地之母绝不会轻易交出宝藏。 贪婪的矮人对山脉造成的破坏越大，它就会对下方摇摇晃晃的胡须们降下越多灾祸。 在天崩地塌之前，平衡好开采与运金的节奏。 掌握矮人一族的夺宝秘术！ 这是一款数值不断飙升的游戏，而如何实现增长，全凭你的思路与巧思。你将拥有： 种类繁多的建筑与矮人，各有优劣特长，比如：炸药投掷手、弩炮、烈焰使者、激光炮、洞穴探险家、符文铁匠、酿酒大师、推土机、旋翼机等！ 海量升级选项，可施放主动仪式，为矮人及其机器提供增益 收集百余件上古神器，陈列在展馆中，每件都能彻底改变你的玩法流派 解锁九十余种威望升级，反复游玩、加速进度、发掘全新联动 消耗秘银、山之魂等稀有资源，做出艰难抉择 揭开诸神藏在世界尖峰之下的秘密，以及那些挖得太深的先驱者们的下场
